method.motion: Gallery merge target geometry: time*.8, radius min(width*.26,height*.24) for portrait, radii ratios1.04/.72/.52, separation .9+.6*sin(time*.8); reusable drop objects. UI easing and gallery layout excluded.
method.scope: Absolute cost of a new scene API; no previous-version fusion speedup, whole-app FPS or physical-device claim.
method.submission: performance.now around staged setDrops and render, excluding the benchmark motion calculation and asynchronous GPU polling.
method.gpu: Optional asynchronous EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2, nanoseconds converted to ms; available non-disjoint samples only. Queries/polling are not inside CPU submission timing.
method.cadence: rAF intervals; shared preview/capture/display may constrain callbacks. Callback cadence is not proof of presented FPS.
method.budget: Explicit maxPixels trades backing resolution for speed. Report actual canvas dimensions and pixel count; do not describe this as equal-quality baseline optimization.
method.resources: Separate instrumented initialization/staging/steady-frame/destruction pass; no instrumentation in timing runs.
